title: campaign-v0.1
description: An ordered campaign of one-fault runs that a consumer is driven through, run after run. It names what each run's session must inject and nothing about what the consumer should do: no expected action, no deadline and no label. Truth stays in each run's sealed record.

domain.description: The domain the campaign starts in; a run names its own.

seed.description: The campaign seed every run seed is drawn from.

index.description: The run's place in the campaign, counted from 1.

phase.description: A free label the campaign's author gave this stretch of runs, such as learn, holdout or disturb.

domain.description: The domain this run's session plays.

seed.description: The world seed of the run's session.

duration_s.description: How long the run lasts in simulated seconds.

session_plan.description: The file, beside campaign.json, holding the run's session-plan-v0.1.
